baseline.title: Military data center resource planning
baseline.summary: Requires the Defense Department's computing roadmap to address electricity, water, community effects and utility resilience for data centers built or expanded on military installations. Estimates are conditioned on not delaying the roadmap update. This is a targeted military provision, not a general commercial data center law.

baseline.title: Ratepayer Protection Act stalls in Senate
baseline.summary: Passed the House 417–3 on September 16. Senate cloture on proceeding failed 57–43 on September 30. The bill would require utility regulators to consider a cost-recovery standard for large data center loads; it would not require every state to adopt that standard. It is not enacted.
